summary: Describes how a DNS resolver can run a copy of the root zone on a loopback address to get faster answers and to keep requests from being observed. It explains how to set up and maintain such a copy safely. It was replaced by RFC 8806.

eli5.summary: Instead of phoning far away for a directory, you keep a copy at home. It was replaced by RFC 8806.

questions: can i run a root server on loopback
why run a local copy of the dns root zone
